decision.reasoning_trace: After reviewing the product feed, I excluded accessories like chargers and cases. I focused on speakers with high ratings and substantial review counts. My consideration set included the high-performance Sony XB43 and JBL Flip 5, the budget-friendly EDUPLINK, the versatile Philips BT6000B, and the niche My Audio Pet. I ultimately chose the JBL Flip 5 because of its exceptional 4.8 rating across more than 68,000 reviews, its proven waterproof design, and its reasonable price point compared to the more expensive Sony and Audio Pro models. This purchase keeps the no-purchase rate near the 30% target for the experiment.
